problem_statement:
Carrel only lists posts and pages; other site kinds are invisible and editor links all point at /blog/

For a dustinedwards.info project, Carrel's writing lists (the project page's item list, its kind filter and the search over the index) show only items of kind `post` and `page`. The site also reports publications, documents, cv, dictionary, roster, phage and procedure items, and none of them appear. Meanwhile the lab registry kinds (equipment, reagent, primer, strain) must stay out of the lists.

Second, the editor's link picker builds every link as `/blog/<item id>`, which is wrong for anything the site serves elsewhere.

Third, when the site rejects a write with an `invalid` or `not-implemented` error, Carrel shows a generic failure instead of the site's own message.

Expected:
- A kind counts as writing when any of the project's indexed items of that kind has a page on the site (a non-null path) or is not yet published. Data kinds (published, no path) stay in the index but out of every list, filter and kinds list, whatever they are called.
- The editor loader's `linkTargets` give each target an `href` equal to the item's own site path; an item without a path takes its published siblings' prefix with its own id (a draft post goes to `/writing/<id>`); items with no known address are left out.
- `invalid` and `not-implemented` site errors surface as a refusal with the site's message.
fail_to_pass: npx vitest run test/index.test.ts -t "keeps a site's data kinds out of the writing lists"
npx vitest run test/kinds.test.ts -t "lists each writing kind under its own kind"
npx vitest run test/kinds.test.ts -t "opens, saves, previews, publishes and shows the history of a non-post kind"
pass_to_pass: npx vitest run test/kinds.test.ts -t "keeps a data kind out of the lists"
npx vitest run test/index.test.ts -t "reads a body again only when the item changed"
setup: git config --global url."https://github.com/".insteadOf ssh://git@github.com/ && npm ci
